_comment: Frozen result artifacts for the Dr.DocBench submissions. The run outputs live outside the repository (on the cluster scratch); this file preserves the numbers, the submission zip hashes and the composition of each run so the performance work can be resumed. No ground truth or predictions are stored here.
metric: EvalAI Overall (per-page mean of the available components)

submissions.composition: tree_differ_v2 lambda=0.5 tau=0.6 over docling-v3 + mineru-v3 (acessilia d6d1348, toolbox 6be3685)
tree_differ_v2 args v13-pnt over docling-v3+rot x mineru-hyb+rot (MinerU hybrid-VLM, 491 pages + 16 rot + 2 fallback)
submissions.note: TEDS did NOT transfer: dev +5.9 -> test +0.2. The real test gain came from reading order (+16.4, 55.91 -> 72.3) with the MinerU hybrid-VLM + rotation source.
-0.02 vs v15-hyb; better reading order (+2.66), slightly worse text/TEDS.

dev_best_unconfirmed.note: Never submitted or confirmed on the leaderboard. The observed dev->test gap is ~8 points. Reproducible via FusionPolicy.drbench_best_method(), which is named and never a default.

gap_dev_to_test.note: The dev split evaluates isolated pages; the test split uses 34 documents x 15 contiguous pages. Part of the gap is the window, not the method.
